title: Best Geyser Under ₹10,000 in India (2026): Storage Picks
description: We compared 8 storage geysers under ₹10,000 — Crompton, AO Smith, Havells, Bajaj. 5-star BEE, hard water protection, 5-7 year tank warranty. 4 picks + 1 skip.

headings.text: What actually matters in a geyser under ₹10,000
Storage vs instant geyser: which to buy
What a geyser adds to your power bill

cta.headline: Bathroom geyser at the right price?
cta.sub: A ₹10,000 storage geyser with 5-star BEE rating and 5+ year tank warranty is the sweet spot for Indian homes. We ranked each model for hard water, electricity, and long-term reliability.

faq.q: Storage or instant geyser — which is better?
faq.a: Storage (10-25L) for bathroom — gives 8-15 min of hot water for a bath. Instant (1-3L) for kitchen — gives 5-10 min for washing dishes. Don't use instant in bathroom (3L is not enough for a bucket bath). Don't use storage in kitchen (15L is overkill for hand-wash).

faq.q: How long does a geyser take to heat water?
faq.a: 15L storage: 8-12 minutes. 10L storage: 5-8 minutes. 3L instant: 30-60 seconds. 1L instant: 10-20 seconds. The 4 storage picks above all heat 15L in 10-12 minutes at 2000W.

faq.q: What's the best BEE rating for a geyser?
faq.a: 5-star is the highest. 5-star geysers use 15-20% less electricity than 4-star at the same capacity. The difference on a monthly bill is ₹50-100 for a family of 4. Worth the ₹500-1,000 upfront premium.

faq.q: How long does a geyser last?
faq.a: 8-12 years for AO Smith, Crompton, Havells, Bajaj. 5-7 years for V-Guard and cheaper brands. The tank is the failure point — usually from corrosion in hard water. Magnesium anode extends tank life by 2-3 years. Look for 5-7 year tank warranty.

Vertical is standard for storage geysers (90% of installations). Horizontal is for some special installations (low ceiling, narrow wall) but is less common. Most brands offer vertical only at this price. The 4 picks above are vertical mount.

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the Crompton Solarium Qube 15L (SWH215, 5-star). 15L for families of 3-4, 5-star BEE rating for lowest electricity, glass-lined tank with magnesium anode for hard water protection, and 5-year tank warranty. The best balance of brand reliability, hard water protection, and price under ₹10,000.
key_takeaways: 15L is right for families of 3-4; 10L for 2-3 people; 25L for 5+.
5-star BEE rating saves ₹150-200/month on electricity vs 4-star.
5-7 year tank warranty is the real number; anode extends tank life.
Magnesium anode and glass-lined tank are critical in hard water cities.
who_for: Indian households who need a reliable storage geyser for bathroom use. Ideal for families of 3-4 in metro cities with hard water (Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad), buyers who want to minimize electricity bills, and anyone who wants a 5-year warranty without paying for premium brands.
methodology: We compared 8 storage geysers available on Amazon India, Flipkart, and brand stores under ₹10,000. For each, we evaluated capacity (10L to 25L), BEE star rating, wattage, tank material, magnesium anode presence, tank warranty, and service network. Cross-referenced long-term reliability from Indian home appliance forums. Reviewed every 45 days.
